title: Fix texture streaming uniform buffer binding index
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #123626

## Additional information

When resolving conflicts for SSCS, I missed this instance.

mrp: [test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32437027/test.zip)

With both SDFGI and texture stream enabled it should produce the following errors on master:
```
  ERROR: All the shader bindings for the given set must be covered by the uniforms provided. Binding (38), set (1) was not provided.
  ERROR: servers/rendering/renderer_rd/uniform_set_cache_rd.h:119 - Condition "rid.is_null()" is true. Returning: rid
  ERROR: servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:5916 - Parameter "uniform_set" is null.
  ERROR: Uniforms were never supplied for set (1) at the time of drawing, which are required by the pipeline.
```

Fixing the binding issue resolves this.
